title: Mobile robot motion control and autonomous navigation in GPS-denied outdoor environments using 3D laser scanning
authors: Yang Q.; Qu D.; Xu F.; Zou F.; He G.; Sun M.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
